contextAuthor: Little Hanzi assisted editorial draft; human Mandarin and child-suitability review pending

lessons.title: A shady reading spot
lessons.welcome: Our capybara wants a shady place to read. Look for wood and a grove along the path.

characters.hint: Memory picture: notice a trunk with branches on both sides. This is a remembering aid.

words.translation: A piece of wood lies under the tree.
The trees give us shade.

characters.hint: Notice two 木 shapes side by side. Picture more than one tree.

words.translation: There is a little path in the forest.
We read beside the grove.

lessons.title: A moonlit birthday
lessons.welcome: Our capybara has a birthday book. Follow the day into a bright moonlit evening.

characters.hint: Look for one short line inside a tall box. Compare it carefully with 目.

words.translation: Today is a happy day.

words.sentence: 我在生日那天收到一本书。
words.translation: I received a book on my birthday.

characters.hint: Notice the two short lines inside and the open space between the lower strokes.

words.translation: The moon slowly rose.
Moonlight shines on the book beside the window.

lessons.title: Welcome to the picnic
lessons.welcome: Our capybara is meeting friends for a picnic. Notice the people and the doorway where they meet.

characters.hint: Memory picture: two sloping strokes look like someone standing with their legs apart.

words.sentence: 人们在公园里一起野餐。
words.translation: People are having a picnic together in the park.

words.sentence: 大人和孩子一起收拾东西。
words.translation: The adults and children pack things away together.

characters.hint: Notice an empty box with no line inside. Compare it with 日.

words.sentence: 看到好吃的水果，我都要流口水了。
words.translation: The tasty-looking fruit makes my mouth water.
We wait for our friends at the doorway.

lessons.title: Follow the stream
lessons.welcome: Our capybara follows a little stream beside a hill. Help notice mountain and water words.

characters.hint: Memory picture: three upright strokes can remind you of three mountain peaks.

words.translation: There is a tree on the hilltop.
Little flowers bloom on the hillside.

characters.hint: Notice the long middle stroke and the strokes spreading to both sides.

words.translation: We brought a box of fruit.
The river water flows under the little bridge.

lessons.title: Choose a book bag
lessons.welcome: Our capybara is packing for school. Compare big and small things before choosing a bag.

characters.hint: Memory picture: imagine a person stretching both arms wide to show something big.

words.sentence: 这两个书包的大小不一样。
words.translation: These two schoolbags are different sizes.
The strong wind blew the leaves into the air.

characters.hint: Look for a middle stroke with one little stroke on each side.

words.sentence: 我的小学旁边有一个公园。
words.translation: There is a park beside my primary school.
The child puts a book into the schoolbag.

lessons.title: Find the missing hat
lessons.welcome: Our capybara cannot find its school hat. Look above and below as you help with the search.

characters.hint: Notice that the short strokes are above the long horizontal line.

words.translation: The hat is on top of the bookshelf.
We follow the little path up the hill.

characters.hint: Notice that the short strokes are below the long horizontal line.

words.translation: The kitten sleeps under the table.
It is raining, so we take an umbrella.

lessons.title: Plant a seed
lessons.welcome: Our capybara visits a garden with a friend. Notice the fields and the soil where plants grow.

characters.hint: Memory picture: the lines inside a box can remind you of paths dividing a field.

words.sentence: 田地里长着绿色的蔬菜。
words.translation: Green vegetables grow in the field.
There are little rice seedlings in the paddy field.

characters.hint: Compare the two horizontal lines: the lower line is longer.

words.sentence: 种子藏在湿湿的泥土里。
words.translation: The seed is tucked into the damp soil.
Flowers grow on this patch of land.

lessons.title: A rainy train ride
lessons.welcome: Our capybara has a window seat on a train. Spot fire and rain characters in useful words.

characters.hint: Memory picture: the spreading middle strokes and two small strokes can remind you of a flame.

words.translation: The train slowly pulls into the station.

words.sentence: 我们和大人一起看蜡烛上的火苗。
words.translation: We look at the candle flame together with a grown-up.

characters.hint: Memory picture: notice the little marks inside, like drops seen through a window.

words.translation: Rainwater falls on the window.
I put on my raincoat before going outside.

lessons.title: A careful helper
lessons.welcome: Our capybara helps a friend choose a book. Notice hands, looking, and a little reading goal.

characters.hint: Notice the long middle stroke with a hook and the shorter strokes crossing it.

words.sentence: 一颗小石子放在我的手心里。
words.translation: A little pebble rests in my palm.

words.sentence: 我用双手拿着这本大书。
words.translation: I hold this big book with both hands.

characters.hint: Look for two short lines inside a tall box. 日 has only one inside line.

words.sentence: 他的目光停在那本书上。
words.translation: His gaze rests on that book.

words.sentence: 今天的目标是读完这本书。
words.translation: Today's goal is to finish reading this book.

lessons.title: Ready for school
lessons.welcome: Our capybara has its hat and book bag. Find the door and notice vehicles on the way to school.

characters.hint: Memory picture: notice a doorway shape with a small mark at the upper left.

words.translation: The school gate is open.
The teacher welcomes us at the doorway.

characters.hint: Notice the middle vertical stroke crossing the horizontal strokes.

words.sentence: 这列火车经过一座小桥。
words.translation: This train crosses a little bridge.
We go to school by car.
